status_note: All eleven coverage projections across eleven probe functions match the locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle byte-for-byte (234 stdout lines), including the erase-successor-skip quirk and the retained unreachable block after conversion. The consumed-input chain (possible_unreachable set only by inlineSubFunction, consumed by generateBlocks->removeUnreachableBlocks) is out of scope for this lease and recorded under out_of_scope_observations.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: qlst is Funcdata-owned and passed by reference into FlowInfo (Rugra: fd.callspecs); visited is read-only; data.warningHeader/warning write shared commentdb state; opSetOpcode/opMarkStartBasic/opSetInput/newCodeRef mutate shared PcodeOps and their input varnodes - all observed through spec lists, warning comments, op opcode/flag/input projections and the block graph.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: for(iter=qlst.begin();iter!=qlst.end();++iter) over spec creation order; visited.upper_bound(addr) then one decrement equals BTreeMap range(..=addr).next_back(); the dead-list ++oiter successor lookup walks the SeqNum-ordered bank; after erase the for-header ++iter skips the erased spec's successor (locked by case multi).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No counters or accumulators exist in checkContainedCall; warnings go through addCommentNoDuplicate so repeated identical (fad,addr,text) triples collapse exactly once per site.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: visited is keyed by Address (space,offset) ordered; containment compares start+size<=addr with exact equality start==addr selecting the conversion arm; op iteration for observation is the PcodeOpTree SeqNum (address,then time) order, not creation order.

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus two verified overlays (flow.rs, pcodeinject.rs); unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: Eleven BfdArchitecture shells, one per probe, over the fixture-binary .text compiled from the probes in this fixture's .cc (g++ -O0 -fno-pie -no-pie); each shell follows flow from the probe symbol over the full default code space
analysis_options.probe_construction: naked noinline C functions; every probe body is pure asm so the emitted bytes are exactly the designed instruction stream; endbr64 (4 bytes, -fcf-protection) precedes each body, shifting deltas by +4 on both sides identically
analysis_options.sleigh_spec_rule: the shared x86-64 .sla compiles CALL with zero displacement (target == next instruction) to goto (ia.sinc:2953 'When is a Call a Jump' rule), so getpc/mid never create a call spec; every checkContainedCall-exercising probe uses non-zero displacement internal targets
analysis_options.case_matrix: exact visited-start hit forward and backward, offcut mid-instruction target, target beyond last visited instruction end, target below every visited key, CALLIND opcode guard, callee-Funcdata resolved external symbol, two-call erase-successor skip
analysis_options.debug_macros: __TERMINAL__ only; OPACTION_DEBUG, CPUI_DEBUG and TYPEPROP_DEBUG absent
analysis_options.diagnostics: BfdArchitecture initialization diagnostics captured privately into an ostringstream and excluded from the target API observation; both sides' stderr is required empty
analysis_options.normalization: Three projections normalize proven non-semantic encodings identically on both sides: (1) the PIC warning's embedded call address is printed via Address::printRaw (ram:000...) on Ghidra and 0x-hex Display on Rugra's legacy spaceless Address (ADDRESS-0001) - both sides parse it back to a base-relative delta; (2) the call-spec annotation varnode lives in Ghidra's Fspec space (offset = heap pointer) and Rugra's Iop space (offset = spec index) - projected to the single token 'callspec'; (3) LOAD/STORE input(0) space-reference constants are heap pointers on Ghidra (run-varying) and stable SPACEID_* indices on Rugra - projected to the referenced space name. No op order, aliasing, control flow or state is dropped.

observation_schema.format: Eleven case records in fixed probe order, pipe-free key=value lines: case/calls/spec/warn/blocks/block/op, final newline; 234 lines total

goto_spec_parity.covers: getpc/mid: zero-displacement internal calls compile to goto in the shared .sla; both sides emit BRANCH at lift time, create zero call specs, and produce no warnings (no false positives from checkContainedCall).

exact_match_conversion_fwd.covers: fwd: non-zero displacement call to a later visited instruction start converts CALL->BRANCH, emits the warningheader, restores the code-ref input, marks the following op STARTBASIC, splits the block, and erases the spec (calls=0).

offcut_warning.covers: offcut: target strictly inside a visited 3-byte instruction draws only the 'Call to offcut address within same function' warning attached at the call address; op stays CALL with callspec input and the spec survives (calls=1).

beyond_end_skip.covers: beyond: target at start+size of the last visited instruction below it (never decoded, ret imm16 has no fallthru) silently skips via flow.cc:1377-1378; spec survives, no warning.

erase_successor_skip_quirk.covers: multi: two internal calls; the first converts and erases, and the for-header ++iter skips the successor spec, so the second call stays CPUI_CALL with its callspec (calls=1, one warning). Locks the load-bearing oracle quirk.

exact_match_conversion_back.covers: back: converted call targeting an earlier decoded instruction; target op and following op both STARTBASIC; block graph identical including the retained unreachable ret block.

conversion_unreachable_block_retained.covers: afterc: converted call followed by a conditional branch; the branch block keeps no in-edges and is retained because checkContainedCall does not set possible_unreachable (only inlineSubFunction flow.cc:1274 does); generateBlocks therefore does not call removeUnreachableBlocks.

before_begin_skip.covers: before: call target 0x10 below the function entry (inside the int3 pad, never a symbol start, never decoded) skips via upper_bound==visited.begin() (flow.cc:1375); spec survives with negative entry delta.

callind_opcode_guard.covers: callind: register-indirect call (CPUI_CALLIND) skips on the opcode guard (flow.cc:1370) before any address lookup; spec survives with invalid entry.

funcdata_resolved_skip.covers: extern: call to a real preceding symbol. Ghidra resolves the callee Funcdata in queryCall and skips at flow.cc:1367-1368; Rugra's query_call is a documented no-op (CALLSPEC-0001) so has_funcdata() is false, but the target is below every visited key and the combined observable (spec kept, no warning, op unchanged) is identical.

generateops_do_while_wiring.covers: all cases: checkContainedCall executes on the first do-while pass even with zero BRANCHIND ops (flow.cc:813), matching the Ghidra do-while shape; conversions are observable in the same run as the flow trace.

out_of_scope_observations.note: possible_unreachable is set only by inlineSubFunction (flow.cc:1274) and consumed by generateBlocks calling data.removeUnreachableBlocks(false,true) (flow.cc:843-844). Rugra's generate_blocks already has the has_possible_unreachable -> fd.remove_unreachable_blocks() wiring, but Funcdata::remove_unreachable_blocks itself lives in funcdata.rs outside this lease; its per-function oracle depth belongs to the flow-audit item that owns funcdata.rs. Suggested TODO id for the orchestrator: FUNCDATA-REMOVE-UNREACHABLE-0001.

Ghidra's FlowInfo::checkMultistageJumptables (flow.cc:1408) is still not ported; Rugra approximates the do-while tablelist refill with a fresh BRANCHIND census. Not observable in this fixture (no indirect jumps).

The flow.cc:1367-1368 callee-Funcdata guard runs through a CALLSPEC-0001 adapter that is constant false because Rugra's query_call never resolves a Funcdata. The extern case proves the combined observable is identical when the target is not a visited address; a probe with a resolved Funcdata whose entry is also visited (recursion-style) would need CALLSPEC-0001 linkage to stay aligned.

generateOps' hasInject()->injectPcode() calls (flow.cc:794-795, 819-820) remain unwired in Rugra's generate_ops; injectlist is only populated when FuncCallSpecs::isInline() is true, which the CALLSPEC-0001 adapter never returns, so no behavior difference is observable today (INJECT-0001).
